title: Vegetarian Corned Beef Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty vegetarian stew made with corned beef and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add diced corned beef and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add potatoes, soy sauce, and enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
